summary.text: Fiona Nave is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 56, where Ballotpedia lists her tenure as beginning in 2021, and a computer specialist who is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Nave earned a degree in applied mathematics from California Polytechnic University.

Her career experience includes working as a computer specialist with the U.S. Navy, and she has volunteered with the Stillwater Ambulance District #1 Board and Stillwater Citizens for Property Rights.
In the 2025-2026 session Nave was assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
